proof: TOWN OF LUNENBURG, GENERAL FUND APPROPRIATIONS, `SUMMARY & CLASSIFICATION OF ACCOUNTS`, FISCAL YEAR 2019 -- the Town Accountant's schedule, PDF pages 32 to 36 of the FY2019 annual town report (printed pages 30 to 34): 82 department lines built from 165 printed line items. THE PRINTED HEADER, VERBATIM, READ OFF FY2019'S OWN PAGES and not inherited from another year: `PROGRAM NAME | APPROPRIATED FORWARD | TOTAL FUNDS AVAILABLE | TOTAL EXPENDED | TOTAL ENCUMBERED | BALANCE TO REVENUE`, repeated at the top of pp.32, 34, 35 and 36. ALL FIVE PAGES ARE PHOTOGRAPHS -- pdfplumber returns 0 words for every one -- and THE TWO HALVES OF THE RUN ARE STORED DIFFERENTLY, which is a property of the page and not of the report: pp.32-35 carry one JBIG2Decode image each at 4400x3400 (400 dpi, the best resolution in this archive) and p36 carries a JPXDecode image at 1275x1651 (150 dpi). pdfminer CANNOT DECODE EITHER -- `stream.get_data()` hands back the undecoded codestream and PIL refuses it -- and there is no jbig2dec, pdfimages, mutool, gs or PyMuPDF on this machine, so every page was read through pypdfium2's `get_bitmap(render=False)`, which returns the page's OWN stored bitmap rather than a rasterisation of the page. NO RECOGNITION WAS USED and the committed OCR TSV for these pages is not a starting point: it lost the top band of most of them, which is what the 47 FY2019 appropriations rows in table-corrections.csv exist to patch. WHAT PROVES THE WHOLE TABLE, and it is five independent things, all computed before this file was written: (1) each of the 82 departments foots its own printed line items in all four of the columns it prints them in -- 0 failures; (2) each of the 82 departments satisfies TOTAL FUNDS AVAILABLE - TOTAL EXPENDED - TOTAL ENCUMBERED = BALANCE TO REVENUE -- 0 failures; (3) the 82 department lines sum to the printed GRAND TOTAL in ALL FIVE columns, EXACTLY -- 41,178,985.82 / 41,178,985.82 / 40,057,293.56 / 283,034.02 / 838,658.24; (4) the 165 LINE ITEMS sum to the same printed GRAND TOTAL in four columns, exactly, which is an independent route to the same figures; and (5) THE PRINTED LEGENDS AT THE FOOT OF p36 TIE TO THE CENT -- `fwd - forward from FY 2018 $527,104.02` against the 18 lines marked fwd, `srt - Salary Reserve Transfer $16,605.80` against the 5 lines marked srt, and `rft - Reserve Fund Transfer $0.00` against no rft marker anywhere in the run. Nothing was adjusted to make any of these close and nothing here is attested: the document foots itself everywhere it is checkable. A `fwd`, `srt` OR `rft` MARKER IS A LINE OF THE APPROPRIATED FORWARD COLUMN, NOT AN ANNOTATION. TWO FILES, TWO GRAINS OF ONE TABLE, AND THEY MUST NEVER BE ADDED TOGETHER: `fy2019-p32-appropriations.csv` holds the 82 DEPARTMENT lines and `fy2019-p32-appropriations-detail.csv` holds the 165 LINE ITEMS beneath them. Each proves something the other cannot -- the department grain carries BALANCE TO REVENUE, which the page prints on a department line, and the line grain is the only independent check on the figures those departments are made of. FUND_NUMBER IS THE PRINTED POSITION, NOT THE LABEL: `Other Expenses` is printed twelve times on p32 alone and `Payroll` and `Payroll-Clerical` under several departments, so a key built from the label cannot tell two rows apart -- which is a live defect in `apply_corrections()`, see below. WHAT THE PAGE DOES NOT PRINT IS RECORDED AS BLANK, NEVER AS ZERO. 43 department lines print no TOTAL ENCUMBERED cell at all. TWO DEPARTMENTS PRINT NO BALANCE TO REVENUE -- `Transfer to Stabilization Funds/OPEB` and `Transfer to Capital Project Fund`, both on p36, which the GRAND TOTAL row immediately follows; reading those as 0.00 would make a row the town left blank look like a row it footed. `Art 11/07 ATM Master Plan Consulting` (p33) and `Reserve Fund` (p36) print no TOTAL EXPENDED cell, and three line items print none either -- Emergency Management :: Other Expenses and General Health Expense :: Other Expenses (p34). `Town Reports` (p36) prints a line labelled `Payroll` WITH NO FIGURE IN ANY COLUMN; it is a printed label and not a figure, so it is recorded nowhere rather than as a zero. TWO DEPARTMENTS DO NOT PRINT THEIR OWN APPROPRIATED FORWARD TOTAL, because their single printed row IS the total row and the forward sits on a separate line above it -- `School Department - Curriculum Adoption` (p35: 13,671.96 fwd + 17,686.00) and `Physicals` (p36: 577.18 fwd + 4,084.49). The department figure recorded here is the sum of those two printed cells, and the page asserts it independently: in both cases it equals the TOTAL FUNDS AVAILABLE the same row prints (31,357.96 and 4,661.67). No digit was chosen by arithmetic. FIGURES THAT LOOK LIKE MISREADS AND ARE NOT, each required by its own department's printed total: Conservation Commission :: Payroll is EXPENDED 48,928.56 against an appropriation of 48,927.06 (p33); Fire Department :: Payroll-Firefighters/Daymen is EXPENDED 726,424.50 against 610,775.10 (p33); School Department :: Other Expenses is EXPENDED 6,270,439.44 against 6,242,958.47 (p35); and four STATE & COUNTY ASSESSMENTS lines carry NEGATIVE balances printed in parentheses (p36) -- Special Education (2,779.00), Charter Tuitions (89,725.00) and the department's own total (12,935.00). WHAT THIS IS AND IS NOT: these are APPROPRIATIONS and what was spent against them in FY2019. The `FY 2020 Omnibus Budget` on pp.161-164 of the same report is a different quantity -- a budget PROPOSED for the following year -- and the two must never be compared as though they were the same thing.
